app.name: CRISP-QES
app.tagline: Citizen petitions signed with Diia QES — without revealing your identity
app.footnote: Independent open-source client. Not an official Diia service.

landing.lede: An open-source client for collecting publicly verifiable signatures on citizen-initiative petitions. Signing happens entirely in your browser using your Diia QES (.p7s) file. Only a zero-knowledge proof and a nullifier reach the Base blockchain — never your name, tax ID, or document serial.
guarantees: No party — not us, not the smart contract, not a network observer — learns your name, tax ID, passport serial, or certificate identifier.
One certificate signs each petition at most once. Replays by the same QES are rejected by an on-chain nullifier.
Signature counts are publicly auditable. Anyone can recompute the tally from on-chain data and confirm we have not invented signatures.
Petition text is stored on-chain verbatim. No backend can silently edit it.
limits: The nullifier is deterministic per certificate and per petition. It does not link two of your signatures across different petitions, but if you re-issue your Diia QES you can sign the same petition twice.
The proof is generated in your browser — a non-trivial computation (30s–2min) that requires a modern device with sufficient memory.
The on-chain transaction is submitted by a sponsor relayer. The relayer sees your IP address and timing; metadata-correlation attacks are still possible unless you use Tor or a VPN.
The trusted CA list (LOTL) is frozen at contract deployment. If Diia rotates the roots, the contract must be redeployed or the trust-root upgraded.

list.heading: Open petitions
list.empty: No petitions have been created yet. Any wallet can create one via the PetitionRegistry contract.
list.error: Could not read the petition registry. Check the network configuration.

upload.headline: Drop your .p7s file here or click to choose
upload.hint: The file is produced by the Diia app under «Накласти КЕП». It stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
upload.wrongPrefix: This certificate is not a Ukrainian Diia QES (expected TINUA- prefix).

nullifier.explainer: The nullifier is a public, deterministic value that the contract uses to prevent double-signing. It does NOT contain your name or identifier and does NOT link this signature to any of your other petitions.
nullifier.label: Your nullifier for this petition

prove.intro: Your browser will now compute the ZK proof. This takes 30 seconds to 2 minutes — do not close the tab.

submit.intro: The proof is ready. Submit your signature to Base via the relayer.

create.heading: Create a petition
create.intro: Publish a petition text into the PetitionRegistry contract on Base. Creating a petition requires connecting a wallet and locking a refundable anti-spam deposit.

privacy.title: What is visible on-chain
privacy.body: Creating a petition is a public action. Your wallet address is recorded in the contract as the petition's creator. This is fundamentally different from signing, which remains anonymous via the ZK proof. The petition text is also stored on-chain verbatim.

form.title: Petition content
form.textPlaceholder: Write the petition: the problem, the demand on a public body, the reasoning. UTF-8, up to 8 KB.
form.deadlineHint: Signatures are accepted up to this moment. After this, the petition closes and the deposit becomes withdrawable.
form.thresholdHint: Number of signatures at which the petition is considered to have gathered support.

validation.emptyText: The petition text cannot be empty.
validation.textTooLarge: The text exceeds the 8 KB limit — the contract will reject the transaction.
validation.deadlineInPast: The deadline must be in the future.
validation.thresholdInvalid: The threshold must be a positive integer.

deposit.title: Anti-spam deposit
deposit.body: The deposit is locked by the contract and refundable to the creator after the petition's deadline has passed — regardless of whether the threshold was reached.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.needed: Creating a petition requires a wallet holding ETH on Base Sepolia. Pick the wallet you want to use.
wallet.walletConnectHint: QR code for a mobile wallet
wallet.noInjected: No browser-extension wallet detected. Install MetaMask, Rabby, or any other EIP-1193 wallet, or use WalletConnect for a mobile wallet.
wallet.wrongChain: Wallet is on chain {{current}}; expected {{target}}. Please switch to Base Sepolia.
